French Riviera, Monaco private marina at golden hour. A sculptural deep obsidian-black exotic grand touring supercar with champagne brake calipers parked diagonally on pale stone quay in the close foreground, its glossy body reflecting warm sun. Beside it a second elegant champagne-silver performance coupe partially visible, both unbranded, immaculate realistic wheels and bodywork. Behind the cars, a spectacular white multi-deck superyacht moored in calm dark turquoise water, a few distant luxurious yachts and terraced Riviera buildings. Low three-quarter camera position, cars occupy lower right and yacht silhouette upper right, dark foreground on left. A breeze gently ripples the water, fine realistic specular reflections move over the car. The scene feels private, quiet, exceptionally expensive.
Create a premium photoreal cinematic luxury brand film, 6 seconds, one continuous shot with absolutely no cuts. Ultra-realistic materials, refined architectural and automotive editorial photography, natural restrained color grading, rich ink-black shadows, champagne-gold highlights, soft warm golden-hour sunlight, subtle film grain, tasteful anamorphic character without letterbox bars. Camera makes a very slow perfectly smooth rightward dolly with gentle forward push, constant velocity from first to final frame, no speed ramps, no abrupt ending. Compose key subject center-right; keep lower-left dark and visually quiet for later website typography. No text overlays, no titles, no watermarks, no added graphics, no legible logos. Landscape 16:9, beautifully detailed, physically coherent motion.

Monumental pale travertine planes, floor-to-ceiling bronze-framed glass, generous cantilevered upper story, interior golden light, tasteful cream designer loungers, mature Mediterranean olive trees, distant blue sea. Architectural editorial composition with mansion mainly center-right and calm dark pool foreground on left. Smooth rightward lateral tracking just above water level slowly reveals more of the residence, extremely subtle pool ripples catch warm champagne sunset. No people. Realistic structural geometry, coherent windows and straight lines, understated billionaire villa.
